'''Ruth Ann Killion''' (1949–2021) was an American government statistician who worked for the [[United States Census Bureau]].

==Education and career==
Killion was born on November 2, 1949, in [[Springfield, Illinois]], where her father was a minister.{{r|obit}} She was educated at [[Florida State University]], earning a master's degree in statistics there in 1973.{{r|fsu}}

She worked for many years in the Census Bureau,{{r|obit}} and as executive director of the Office for Research, Planning, and Evaluation of the [[Evangelical Lutheran Church in America]].{{r|wss98}} At the Census Bureau, she served as chief of the statistical research division,{{r|wss93}} of the decennial statistical studies division,{{r|wss98}} of the planning, research and evaluation division,{{r|through}} and of the demographic statistical methods division.{{r|wss12}}

She retired from the Census Bureau in 2019, and died on November 23, 2021.{{r|obit}}

==Recognition==
In 2016, Killion was elected as a [[Fellow of the American Statistical Association]].{{r|fasa}}
